# akp_oidc_issuer (Resource)

Manages a trusted OIDC issuer for the organization. Service accounts bind to an issuer so workloads it identifies (a GitHub Actions workflow, a Kubernetes service account, an Entra application) can exchange their tokens for Akuity credentials. `name` is immutable; every other attribute is updated in place. Changing the issuer URL or its keys revokes every credential issued to the accounts bound to it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_url` (String) The `iss` claim tokens carry, e.g. `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`. Must be https unless the server allows insecure issuer URLs.
- `key_source` (String) Where signing keys come from: `discovery` reads them from the issuer's `.well-known/openid-configuration`, `jwks_uri` fetches the URL in `jwks_uri`, `static_jwks` uses the document in `static_jwks`.
- `name` (String) Unique name within the organization. Immutable: changing it replaces the issuer, which breaks the bindings of its service accounts.

### Optional

- `audiences` (List of String) Audiences accepted on subject tokens. Omit to accept only the server-assigned `default_audience`; set for providers that cannot mint a custom audience (for example Microsoft Entra).
- `jwks_uri` (String) JWKS URL. Required when `key_source` is `jwks_uri`, must be unset otherwise.
- `static_jwks` (String) JWKS document as a JSON string, e.g. via `jsonencode` or `file`. Required when `key_source` is `static_jwks`, must be unset otherwise. Only RSA (2048 bits or more) and EC signing keys are used.
- `token_ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of the credentials minted for this issuer's service accounts, between 60 and 86400 seconds. Defaults to 3600.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of issuer creation
- `default_audience` (String) The audience the server assigns to this organization; subject tokens must carry it unless `audiences` is set.
- `id` (String) Issuer ID
- `keys_updated_time` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last change to the issuer's key configuration. Empty until the first change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by issuer ID.
terraform import akp_oidc_issuer.github_actions 0oloibn1zx313c3f
```
